# discord_roles (Data Source)

Lists all roles in a Discord guild.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_roles" "all" {
  guild_id = "123456789012345678"
}

output "role_names" {
  value = [for r in data.discord_roles.all.roles : r.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The guild's roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `color` (Number) Integer RGB color.
- `hoist` (Boolean) Whether the role is hoisted.
- `id` (String) Role snowflake ID.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the role is integration-managed.
- `mentionable` (Boolean) Whether the role is mentionable.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission names granted to the role.
- `position` (Number) Role position.
